svg.aria-label: Faint share, blends and over-saturated share against guidance weight for the exact model, a trained network and a weaker network
svg.text: 4,096 SAMPLES OF CRESCENT 0 PER POINT · NETWORKS: MEAN OF TWO SEEDS
FAINT SHARE: COVERAGE OF THE LESS TYPICAL LOOK
BLENDS: CONTRASTS NO REAL CRESCENT HAS
Measured. Exact model: closed-form denoisers, 128 DDIM steps. Networks: trained on data with 10% label dropout, 64 DDIM steps.
The networks were sampled up to w = 5; the exact model also at 7.5.
